title: Cross-control-plane administrator
description: Administrative access spans at least four independent enterprise control planes.
businessImpact: A single identity compromise can lead to complete infrastructure takeover.
remediation: Split cloud, source, cluster, and secrets administration into separate JIT roles.

title: AWS administrator access
description: The identity has unrestricted administrative access to AWS.
businessImpact: An attacker can modify or destroy cloud resources and security controls.
remediation: Replace administrator access with task-specific roles and JIT elevation.

title: Wildcard IAM permission
description: The identity can perform every IAM action.
businessImpact: The identity can create persistence and escalate any principal.
remediation: Replace iam:* with an allowlist of required IAM operations.

title: PassRole with workload creation
description: PassRole combined with workload creation can execute code under a stronger role.
businessImpact: A developer can become a production administrator without a direct assignment.
remediation: Constrain PassRole resources and enforce permission boundaries.

title: Access-key creation capability
description: The identity can create new long-lived IAM access keys.
businessImpact: New credentials can provide stealthy persistence outside normal SSO controls.
remediation: Deny access-key creation and require federated short-lived credentials.

title: Read and export sensitive S3 data
description: The identity can read protected objects and copy them outside the approved boundary.
businessImpact: Customer or regulated data can be exfiltrated using valid credentials.
remediation: Separate read and export duties and restrict destinations using policy conditions.

title: Cloud audit tampering capability
description: The identity can stop audit collection and delete its evidence.
businessImpact: Malicious activity may become invisible to incident response and compliance teams.
remediation: Protect CloudTrail with an isolated security account and explicit deny controls.

title: Kubernetes cluster administrator
description: The identity holds unrestricted cluster-admin privileges.
businessImpact: A compromise affects every workload, secret, and namespace in the cluster.
remediation: Replace cluster-admin with namespace-scoped roles and JIT elevation.

title: Kubernetes wildcard RBAC
description: Wildcard verbs and resources grant unrestricted Kubernetes API access.
businessImpact: The identity can control current and future Kubernetes resource types.
remediation: Replace wildcard RBAC with explicit verbs, resources, and namespaces.

title: RBAC bind and escalate permissions
description: Bind and escalate allow privileges beyond the identity's current effective access.
businessImpact: The identity can grant itself or another principal cluster-level administration.
remediation: Remove bind and escalate from human roles and require controlled approval.

title: Secrets read with pod execution
description: Secret reads combined with pod execution expose workload and external credentials.
businessImpact: An attacker can steal service tokens and pivot into connected systems.
remediation: Separate workload deployment from secret access and use an external secrets broker.

title: Repository administration with Actions secrets
description: Repository administration and Actions secret access enable trusted pipeline abuse.
businessImpact: Malicious code can be deployed using valid production credentials.
remediation: Separate repository administration from environment secret approval.

title: Long-lived workload credential
description: A machine identity uses a static credential rather than workload federation.
businessImpact: A leaked key remains reusable and may bridge CI/CD into production.
remediation: Replace static credentials with OIDC workload identity federation.

title: Create vendor and approve payment
description: The identity can create a vendor and approve its payment.
businessImpact: A single employee can create and pay a fraudulent vendor without independent review.
remediation: Separate vendor creation and payment approval with dual control.

title: Create user and assign administrator
description: The identity can create a new account and assign it an administrative role.
businessImpact: An attacker can establish a privileged backdoor identity.
remediation: Separate identity provisioning from privileged role assignment.

title: Dormant privileged identity
description: A privileged identity has not been active for at least ninety days.
businessImpact: Unmonitored dormant access provides an attractive persistence path.
remediation: Disable dormant privileged accounts and require access recertification.
